title: research: ks_entry() silent NULL on backend type mismatch
description: wp11_backend_keystore.c:68-80 -- ks_entry() returns NULL silently if the handle's backend field does not match any compiled-in backend type. This causes sign/verify/decrypt to return -1 with no indication of why. Research question: can this path be reached in practice with valid PKCS11 call sequences, or is the backend field always set correctly by the layer above? If reachable, return a distinct error code or ASSERT. If unreachable, add a compile-time check.
